lines.text: Sephie gets into her wheelchair.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Sephie, do you have your medication?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Yeah, I packed it in this bag.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: And the thermometer?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Right here in my pocket.
It might get chilly, so let's bring a blanket, too.
I take the blanket from the bed and wrap it around Sephie.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: And now we're all set.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: But is it really okay for us to be doing this?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Last time I ran away, it was just me,

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: but now you and the Captain are involved too...
Sephie gives Sky a worried look.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Of course, we shouldn't be doing this.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We can't just ignore protocol and do whatever we want.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... But right now, we have to.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We don't want to regret this later, after all.
I slide the door open.
Sky wheels the wheelchair up to the doorway,
then pushes it out into the corridor.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Don't make a sound, Sephie.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Yeah, I'm super quiet right now.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I'm not even breathing.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: You don't have to hold your breath...
Suddenly, we hear a door slide open.
Pepper and Mary step out of another patient's room.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Just make sure you take your medicine, and you'll be out of here in no time!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, we'll come by again soon.
We hide behind a pillar.
Looks like they're making their rounds.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Should we just make a run for the exit?
No, I'll distract them.
You guys just try to sneak past.
I approach Pepper cautiously.
Pepper, can I talk to you for a sec?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Huh? Oh, Commander!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: What are you doing here?
I wanted to ask you a few things about Sephie.
Like what her treatment plan looks like going forward, and if there's anything we should watch out for...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: By the way, has Sephie agreed to the surgery?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I went ahead and scheduled it like you asked, but...
... We're still working on it.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Not yet, huh...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I was just about to head to Sephie's room anyway. Why don't we talk there?
N-no, let's just talk here!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: ... In the corridor?
Sephie might get worried if she overhears us.
Since it's a sensitive topic, I'd rather talk about it privately when she's not around.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: ... You're right.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You really are so thoughtful, Commander!

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: ... Hehe.
Something about Mary's laughter bothers me.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: First, let me go over her treatment plan with you.
As Pepper starts explaining, Sky begins pushing the wheelchair.
Just then,
the wheels let out a loud creak.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Huh? I thought I heard something just now...
How long will the surgery take? What are the chances of success? And how long will recovery take?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I-it's hard to answer so many questions all at once.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Let me answer them one at a time!
Meanwhile, the wheelchair slowly rolls toward the end of the hallway.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Sky, we're like spies.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Shh, keep your voice down.
The blanket draped over Sephie slowly slips off.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Oh, my blanket!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Hm? I think I just heard a familiar voice...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Sephie?!
Pepper studies my face.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Commander, don't tell me...

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: You only asked for a consultation to keep me here this whole time?!
S-Sky! Run as fast as you can!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Yes, Captain!
The wheelchair rattles loudly
as Sky and I race down the corridor.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: A patient has escaped! We need help!
*Wee-ooo! Wee-ooo!* The emergency alarm blares,
and hospital staff come running from all directions.
Let's turn at that corner!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Okay! Hold on tight, Sephie!
*Screeeech!*
The wheelchair skids around the corner, narrowly avoiding the wall.
Just as we make the turn, a meal cart blocks our path.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: A meal cart like that's not gonna stop us!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: If you wanna block our way, bring three of 'em!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Hyah!
Sky deftly dodges the meal cart without slowing down.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Ahaha! This is so much fun!

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: But, Sky, you're acting so differently from usual!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Keep your mouth closed, Sephie, or you'll bite your tongue!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We're turning left, so hold on tight!
Sky whips around the left corner in a clean drift.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Captain! How's the elevator looking?
The floor indicator shows it's stopped several floors above us.
There's no time to waste. Let's take the emergency stairs!
I'll lift the front of the wheelchair. Sky, you take the back!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Okay!
Sky and I lift the wheelchair with Sephie still in it.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Wow, I feel like I'm flying!
*Tap, tap, tap*
Together, we race down the stairs, carrying the wheelchair between us.
Behind us, the hospital staff's footsteps are closing in again.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I see the main entrance!

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Once we make it through there, we'll—

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Stop right there!
The wheelchair skids to a stop.
Pepper stands before us, blocking the main entrance.
How did you get here so fast...?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I took a shortcut, of course!

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I know this hospital like the back of my hand.
The hospital staff are closing in behind us,
while Pepper blocks our path ahead.
We're trapped. There's nowhere left to go, nowhere left to run.
Pepper, can't you make an exception just this once?

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: First, please explain why you did something like this.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Why are you suddenly trying to get her out of the hospital?

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: ... We thought you wouldn't let Sephie go out.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That's right. She's about to undergo surgery, after all.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: It'd be terrible if her fever got any worse while she was out.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: That's why we tried to escape.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Because there's nothing worse than dying without ever getting to do what you want.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Neither of us wants that. Not me, not Sephie.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We're just one step away.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Just one more step,

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: and Sephie can finally make her dream come true.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: So please, just this once, let us do this.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I understand how you two feel.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: But that's a separate issue from what's most important here.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I can't put anything above my patient's safety...

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Even if it's the patient's only wish?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Let's leave it at that, Pepper.
Mary emerges from the crowd.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Mary...
Mary places a hand on Pepper's shoulder.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Let's give Sephie this one chance to do what she wants.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: We're doctors.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: What we can give Sephie is a tomorrow.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: But what these two are trying to give her is today.
Pepper looks at Sephie.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You need today to have a tomorrow, don't you think?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Besides, you know better than anyone how much time Sephie spent

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: gazing out of her hospital room window, Pepper.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Miss Doctor...

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I want to ride in a hot air balloon and see the sky.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Just once. That's all I ask.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: I promise I won't ask for anything else,

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: so please... just let me ride in one. Just once.
Pepper sighs and relaxes her shoulders.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Just this once.

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Really?!
Pepper turns to look at Sky.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: But I have a few conditions.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: If Sephie shows even the slightest sign that something's wrong, you have to bring her back down immediately.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: I'll go with you as far as the balloon, too.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: That's as far as I'm willing to compromise.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: If you promise to take responsibility and keep your word, I'll give you my permission.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: I promise!
Sky bows her head.
Thanks for letting us do this, Pepper.
And thanks for helping us talk her into it, Mary.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe, you can make it up to me by coming back safe and sound.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: All right, Sephie. This is it, the final step.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: Shall we?

lines.speaker: sephie
lines.text: Yeah! Up into the sky!
And so, we leave the hospital with an unexpected companion.
